reasoning: Every criterion in this mission's own readiness gate is met without exception. The governing invariant - whole-document currentness places an upper bound on node/source currentness - is now enforced generically, deterministically, and additively: computeOperativeDocument's already-computed OperativeDocumentResolution is composed into buildNodeSupersessionIndex/getNodeSupersessionStatus via the existing KNOWN_SUPERSEDED status vocabulary, which every real consumer (semantic tools, verifier, coverage audit, discovery) already treats as the single fail-closed non-current signal - closing the exact node/document trust inconsistency the prior pre-unseen-classifier-remediation session disclosed and left unfixed, on real, frozen Riot evidence, without any Riot-specific code. Ordinary amendments, unresolved targets, forks, and cycles are all structurally protected from false conversion into supersession. The one honest architecture nuance discovered during tracing - that REVIEW_REQUIRED instrument boundaries mean the fix's own reach stops at doc-b for doc-a's own instrument, never overreaching to assert a fact about doc-c the evidence does not support - is disclosed transparently throughout, not hidden, and is itself evidence of correct, disciplined behavior (Rule 4: never guess uncertain relationships), not a residual defect.
notReadyForPhase4: This verdict does NOT declare Phase 4 ready and does NOT declare the classifier/package-graph/instrument-grouping architecture itself finished. A separate, lightweight, genuinely-unseen package confirmation remains REQUIRED before Phase 4, per this mission's own explicit Section 35 prohibition against beginning it in this session.
recommendedFollowUpsNotActionedThisSessi: The instrument-scoping boundary (REVIEW_REQUIRED links never merging two documents into one instrument, per instrument-grouping.ts's own RESOLVED-only merge policy) means a chain with one low-confidence link in the middle will never have its whole-document trust invariant reach all the way across that link in a single instrument's own computation - this is a genuine, disclosed, pre-existing package-graph/instrument-grouping architecture property (not a defect this session introduced or was authorized to fix; package-graph redesign is explicitly out of scope for this mission) that a future session could evaluate for whether cross-instrument whole-document trust propagation is ever needed.
